iOS: Watch Sources now supports strict Verified Cached Only mode. TorBox cache checks recognize real cached torrent objects and verify selected episode files when file listings are available. Uncached, pending and unknown sources stay hidden; bounded retry and clear error states allow a temporary all-sources view. Adds privacy-safe opt-in cache diagnostic codes and regression tests. Preserves existing addons, player, subtitles, Night Mode, TorriODB and device settings.
